name: HYDRA-UMC-NODE-HEALING
notes: Functional v0: health watchdog (gRPC HealthService or HTTP health URL) with guarded recovery - OrchestratorReactor (watchdog.Reactor's real implementation) calls HYDRA-UMC-ORCHESTRATOR's own POST /nodes/:node/recover only for registry entries with a dispatchNode, for a node that stays UNREACHABLE, INVALID or UNHEALTHY past a confirmation wait, a start-up grace, a per-node cooldown and a global budget (a MISCONFIGURED health URL never recovers). checkNode retries a transport-level failure (dial/RPC error) via a bounded, deterministic RetryPolicy (default 3 attempts, exponential backoff 250ms->2s cap) before classifying a node UNREACHABLE, masking transient network blips without an open-ended retry loop. A node that answers but misreports its own identity (missing or mismatched NodeIdentity.Name) is classified StatusInvalid and never trusted or retried - retrying cannot fix a node lying about its own name. A registry entry with a healthUrl is probed with one HTTP GET (2xx healthy, 5xx unhealthy, no answer unreachable and retried, redirect or 4xx invalid and never retried) because no service of the ecosystem implements the gRPC HealthService; the recovery request carries a bearer token when -orchestrator-token or ORCHESTRATOR_TOKEN is set.
